name: Surabaya Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon in Surabaya, Indonesia on 2 August 2026, with 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: Surabaya Marathon 2026 takes place on 2 August 2026 in Surabaya, Indonesia, starting from Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya. The event offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. Registration opens on Thursday, 26 March 2026 at 12:00. This makes it a flexible race for both serious marathoners and casual participants.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, half marathon, full marathon) suit varying fitness levels
Clear registration opening date and time provided for advance planning
Central, accessible venue at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya
cons: Registration does not open until March 2026, months before the race, so early sign-up isn't possible
No information provided on pricing, course route, or amenities

excerpt_quotes.quote: Saya baru pertama berkunjung ke Surabaya dan baru pertama mengikuti Surabaya Marathon ini. Saya sangat senang dan bangga
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Bernard Mwendia Muthoni, 2018 men's open marathon winner, quoted in ANTARA News Jawa Timur

research_highlights: The event traces back to 2017 and was held in 2017, 2018 and 2019 before pausing during the pandemic; 2026 marks its comeback under new organisers with Le Minerale as title sponsor.
2026 edition offers four distances — 5K, 10K, Half Marathon (21K) and Full Marathon (42K) — starting/finishing at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya on Jl. Pemuda.
Official cut-off times are 1h30 for 5K, 2h for 10K, 3h30 for the half marathon, and 7h for the full marathon.

Past editions grew quickly in size: participation rose from roughly 3,000 runners in the first year to 4,400 in year two and over 6,000 by the 2019 edition, with heavy police traffic support (532 officers deployed in 2019).

Course design is a 'City Run' concept looping through central Surabaya past historic landmarks, with the 2019 full marathon route passing main roads including Jalan Ahmad Yani, Indragiri, Darmo and the HR Muhammad underpass.
research_watchouts: The full marathon in past editions started very early (around 4:40am) due to Surabaya's heat, so runners should expect an early wake-up and check current-year start times.
As a large city-street event, expect road closures and heavy traffic management (hundreds of police personnel deployed in past editions), so plan arrival and logistics accordingly.

Genuine participant race reports (independent of official/organiser or news-agency coverage) for the Surabaya Marathon brand specifically are scarce online, so course-condition and crowd-support details beyond official/press descriptions are limited.

faqs.question: When does registration open for the Surabaya Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Surabaya Marathon 2026 opens on Thursday, 26 March 2026 at 12:00. Prospective participants should mark this date and time to ensure they can secure a spot in their preferred distance category before availability fills up.

faqs.question: Where is the Surabaya Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya Marathon 2026 is held in Surabaya, Indonesia, starting at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya. This central venue serves as the starting point for all four race distances offered as part of the event.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Surabaya Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya Marathon 2026 offers four distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of different experience levels to participate on the same event day.

faqs.question: What is the date of the Surabaya Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on 2 August 2026 in Surabaya, Indonesia. Runners across all four distance categories will start from the same venue, Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya, on this date.
